overview: Reference appears to be a LEGO-style Luke Skywalker minifigure in a white outfit holding a blue lightsaber. Plan below breaks the model into 5 major sub-assemblies (keep it micro/brick-built, not a true minifig), totaling ~112 pieces.

subassemblies.name: Head+Hair
subassemblies.description: 1 head: build a tan 2x2 core with 1 face front (use 1 printed 2x2 tile if available; otherwise plain tile), and 1 blond hair cap using 6–10 curved slopes/tiles layered over the top and sides to suggest shaggy hair.

subassemblies.name: Torso+Robe
subassemblies.description: 1 torso: build a white chest block (roughly 4 studs wide) with 2 arms indicated by white side stacks. Add 1 belt stripe across the waist (brown/red using 2–4 plates/tiles) and 1 small pouch detail centered/left on the belt (1 small 1x1/1x2 element).

subassemblies.name: Arms+Hands (Saber Grip)
subassemblies.description: 2 arms forward: build 2 forearms in tan/white (each ~5–7 pieces) angled to meet at center. Add 2 hands as 1x1 round/clip-like details (or 1x1 bricks) to hold the hilt. Leave a 1-stud channel between hands for the lightsaber handle.

subassemblies.name: Lightsaber
subassemblies.description: 1 lightsaber: build 1 silver/gray hilt (stack of 4–6 small round/cylinder-like parts; substitute with 1x1 rounds/plates) plus 1 blue blade (a vertical stack of 8–12 translucent/light-blue 1x1 rounds/plates or a thin column of blue elements).
subassemblies.imageRegion: right side, rising from hands to top-right corner

subassemblies.name: Legs+Boots
subassemblies.description: 2 legs: build 2 white blocky legs (each ~8–10 pieces) with 2 larger feet/boots (each foot ~2–3 pieces). Add 2 tan/gold accent stripes on thighs/shins using 2–4 tiles/plates total to mimic printed markings.
